cases.provenance: Fictional lab dashboard with two independent live reads and schema-defined pending and terminal assay states.

request.title: Reuse sampled assay IDs for pending labels
request.description: The panel shows an earlier sampled analyzing count and pending labels from the complete later batch read. Calls observe independent instants. A missing verdict remains pending, including with null lifecycle; a final verdict settles the assay even with null lifecycle.

expectedDefects.invariant: The complete later batchRecords result determines pendingLabels. An assay can be submitted during the first narrow read and analyzing without a verdict during the later broad read. It must remain in pendingLabels even though its ID was absent from the earlier sample.

evidence.description: The membership check drops an assay that became analyzing between the independent reads, although the later complete result still shows a missing verdict.
